gold_conclusion_summary: Internet and mobile-based interventions (IMI) show evidence of effectiveness in improving mental health for people with overweight/obesity and comorbid depressive symptoms, with 2 of 3 RCTs achieving significant reduction in both depressive symptoms and weight, and 1 RCT showing significant reduction in depressive symptoms only.
corpus_matching_limitation: The official task row lists three included studies but exposes only two matched corpus IDs: 7016 and 7017. The remaining included reference is available as an extracted/raw title, not as a matched corpus record in the accessible public row metadata.
metadata_caveat: The official search_strategies field in the task row appears inconsistent with the IMI/depression PICO, so it was preserved in ignored gold artifacts but omitted from the agent-facing candidate input.
